notes: 0.3.42：修「初始化推送推不完」。两个都是实测撞出来的坑：①capture.ps1 根外路径体检里漏写一个 $（`(v.Replace(...)` 被 PowerShell 当成命令 v.Replace 执行），只在配置里有自定义根时触发，日志里就是「无法将"v.Replace"项识别为 cmdlet」，整次 push 当场失败；②sync.ps1 把「仓库目录不是空的」当成「路径填错了」，可初始化推送时 capture 刚把 16 项配置写进仓库，它被自己的产物挡住直接退出。现在判据换成「仓库里有本插件的脚本（dsh-sync-common.ps1 / sync.ps1 / capture.ps1 任一）就算同步仓库」，只有真填错路径（桌面、下载目录）才拦。顺带把 tools\fix-session-cwd.mjs 也写进初始化骨架，仓库副本与插件 runtime 从此逐字节一致。
notesEn: 0.3.42: fixes "Initialize push never finishes". Two traps found by actually running it: (1) capture.ps1's outside-root path report was missing a $ - `(v.Replace(...)` made PowerShell look for a command named v.Replace; it only fires when the config has a custom root, and it killed the push with `无法将"v.Replace"项识别为 cmdlet`; (2) sync.ps1 read "the repo folder is not empty" as "wrong path", but during an Initialize push capture has just written 16 config items in - it blocked itself with its own output and exited. The test is now "the folder holds this plugin's own scripts (any of dsh-sync-common.ps1 / sync.ps1 / capture.ps1) -> it is a sync repo"; only a genuinely wrong path (Desktop, Downloads) is rejected. The Initialize skeleton now also writes tools\fix-session-cwd.mjs, so the repo copy and the plugin runtime stay byte-identical.
